friction.summary: DB test isolation: adversarial tests that insert mgmt_object grants on a role shared with seed data (budget-approver) can pollute the genesis-owner-seed.test.ts grant count if cleanup afterAll races with cross-file test ordering. Mitigated by using DEV_ROLE_BUDGET (not DEV_ROLE_OWNER) for concurrent probes and by defensive DB cleanup before each run. Root cause: --no-file-parallelism prevents cross-file races but within-file afterAll vs cross-file ordering can still leave DB dirty between runs if a test throws in beforeAll (before cleanup is registered). Recommendation: use per-run tenant UUIDs for all adversarial inserts to avoid polluting seed-data counts.

ADV-5 nodeId injection false finding: initial adversarial probe tested SQL injection via nodeId string. parseScopeElement correctly accepts any string nodeId (JSONB column, parameterized query — no SQL injection risk). The probe was revised to test structural invalidity (missing nodeLevel) instead. This is not a product defect; it is expected correct behavior. The tester note documents the parameterized-query safety.
